item.title: Re: any suggestions for my SCP?
item.content:encoded: Maybe, when hearing, the SCP can record the audio inside their mind, and then repeat it in the same exact way as it was recorded.

item.title: Re: any suggestions for my SCP?
Re: any suggestions for my SCP?
item.content:encoded: Looks interesting. You may want to add a recording function, for example recording an alarm during a containment breach and playing it while in a cafeteria. You could also have it recording an auditory SCP, like SCP-407, or an infohazrd, like things pertaining to SCP ●●|●●●●●|●●|●.

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
LongJumpingMan,

As per the Required Reading, all authors seeking conceptual critique must use the following template:

 **Seeking Greenlights:** Yes or No **Page Type:** SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify) **Genre (Optional):** Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify) **Page Layout (Optional):** **Elevator Pitch:** **Central Narrative:** **Hook/Attention-Grabber:** **Additional Notes:**

Please edit your post to fit the specified format. Do NOT make a new thread. Instead, use the "edit" function, found below the post under "Options". In addition, please note that the last four sections of the template should not exceed 400 words.

Once you've made the changes, please refer to this thread to contact reviewers: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews
